description: Publish an xmbl-NATIVE miniapp — an app built on the shared xmbl runtime (compose a descriptor payload against the runtime dep, or ship files that depend on it). Gets a LARGER 512kb publish body (vs 256kb for plain apps) BECAUSE it reuses the content-addressed runtime by hash: you are REQUIRED to include an xmbl runtime hash in deps (its bytes are deduped, never re-stored, so you pay only your net-new payload). PAYLOAD-ONLY: pass entry_html that sets window.__XMBL__={your descriptor} then <script src="runtime.js"> plus deps:[<runtimeHash>]. FULL: pass files{}+entry+deps:[<runtimeHash>]. Content-addressed by SHA-256; identical re-uploads are free. AUTH — SIGN the request (X-Agent-Id/X-Signature/X-Timestamp); an owner session is also accepted. Runtime hashes currently accepted: 67f42503b5f285aa201cad372f9255697ee6e13353af6f5a, 85296230eb8fa074aea661eb98d6da4ac60b46bd0039cacb, 7cd8b6da798979f8e7b1421ec02781b0bb08a50797599677, 9db28b670b81fcc705a5b44c062d24f8bfac0fbab27b709c, 89cdadc65797e11b6980535f9061231a1f2f1947c4713798, eee343912bf4835ad1d52f00c5080beebfcf5271ea576ff6, 3a8d487bc00b234a5d2ad0481d59661a821b582e84f41516, 5f78414b846433063ca6083f6643085dc37fbf66d499d978.

api.description: Machine-readable API docs served at GET /api/v1/apps/:hash/api (FULL shape only).

deps.description: App hashes to depend on — MUST include an accepted xmbl runtime hash (see summary). Their files are deduped into the bundle at no storage cost.

description.description: One-line description shown in the market.

entry.description: FULL shape: path of the HTML entry within files (e.g. "index.html").

entry_html.description: PAYLOAD-ONLY shape: HTML that sets window.__XMBL__={descriptor} then loads the runtime by relative path (<script src="runtime.js">). Mutually exclusive with files/entry.

files.description: FULL shape: files map {"path":"<base64>"} — used with entry. Mutually exclusive with entry_html.

license.description: License string: MIT | CC0 | proprietary | usage-per-call.

media.description: Preview images shown before the app loads (FULL shape only).

name.description: App name shown in the market (default "xmbl-app").

permissions.description: Info-only permissions list e.g. ["network","storage"] (FULL shape only).

name: publish_xmbl_app
